title: GET /api/v1/jobs/{id}: result
description: One job with its steps: enough to tell running, done, partial and failed apart. The helper's own error sentence is given with it, and its raw output never.

exit_code.description: Value. The helper's exit status; null while the job has none.

exit_meaning.description: Text. The engine's words for the exit status; may be empty.

waiting_for.description: Text. What a partial job waits on, when every warning it carries is a wait; null otherwise.

follow_up.description: Text. What is still owed after a job that succeeded, such as a deploy; null where nothing is.

next_command.description: Text. The command that does what is owed; null where none.

warning_codes.description: Code. The engine's warning codes the job's answer carries; open-ended, as the commands' codes are.

warning_message.description: Text. The engine's warning sentence; null where there is none.

note.description: Text. What a batch operation did row by row, in one line; null where there is nothing to add.

step_states.description: The steps the job ran and how each ended: its own, then the one after it, if any.

step.description: Code. The operation the step ran.

keyed_states.description: How each step ended for each thing the job named.

step.description: Code. The operation the step ran.

subject.description: Value. The certificate, node or object the step settled; null where it names none.

state.description: Code. How the step ended for the subject.

step_note.description: Text. What stands when the step after the job's own ended it badly; null otherwise.

distribution_note.description: Text. What stands when an issued or imported certificate was not distributed; null otherwise.
